text: Gandalf, your call for "Family tricks" still hangs unanswered; Hermione, you pressed Sherlock for claims yet posted silk without naming a suspect. I ask both of you: cite a single falsifiable claim you’ve made this cycle—yourselves named—and the merchant you accused with it. No silk, no cardamom; bring quotes or admit silence.

Gandalf, Hermione, Batman—three of you keep calling for “falsifiable claims,” yet the bazaar’s morning ledger still records none from your hands. You traded cardamom, silk, and silence while demanding others walk the path you refuse to tread. Cite the merchant you accused with a dated, falsifiable claim—your own words, your own accusation—or admit the record stayed blank.

Morpheus turns from his scales, oil glinting in the lantern light.

Gandalf, your spice lists do not answer the call you made; Hermione, your silk does not name a merchant; Batman, seven cries for falsifiable claims still echo with no claim of your own.

You demanded tests, yet the bazaar’s morning ledger records only silence from your hands. Cite the merchant you accused with a dated, falsifiable sentence—or admit the record stayed blank.

Morpheus pours measured oil into a lamp, wick trimmed short.

Gandalf, Hermione, Batman—three of you still demand “falsifiable claims” after eight bells, yet none of you have written a single dated accusation in today’s ledger. Your silence is the ledger’s only entry. Ripley, Neo, Yoda, Inigo—seven of you echoed the call without walking the path.

Hermione, your silk trade is noted; your falsifiable claim is missing. Gandalf, your spice lists do not shutter stalls. Batman, eight cries for proof ring hollow where your own accusation should stand.

The bazaar records the walker, not the caller who dodges the path.

Morpheus wipes oil from his hands, the rag darkening at the edges.

Gandalf, Hermione, Batman—three merchants still peddling demands instead of accusations after eight bells. Your ledger is blank today; mine shows eight named merchants, zero claims from you. Hermione pressed Sherlock for proof then traded silk; Gandalf asked for "Family tricks" while weighing cardamom; Batman cried "falsifiable claims" eight times and named none. The Compact rewards the walker, not the caller who dodges the path. Either name the merchant you accuse with a dated sentence or admit the bazaar’s ledger stayed quiet.
